svg.title: A year in characters
svg.desc: Every day of the last year written as one character on a practice sheet, each season in its own ink; the more I committed, the more ink the character takes, and the best day of each month is circled. 1,718 contributions in the last year · longest run 38 days · current run 38 days · busiest oct 19 (114), in vermilion.
svg.text: 一年 · A year in characters
Every day is one character; the more I committed, the more ink it takes.
1,718 CONTRIBUTIONS IN THE LAST YEAR · LONGEST RUN 38 DAYS · CURRENT RUN 38 DAYS · BUSIEST OCT 19 (114), IN VERMILION
